# jsdiff

Locally served browser distribution of `diff@8.0.4` from
https://github.com/kpdecker/jsdiff (BSD-3-Clause; see LICENSE).

Downloaded with `npm pack diff@8.0.4`; `dist/diff.min.js` is unmodified.
NPM tarball integrity:
`sha512-DPi0FmjiSU5EvQV0++GFDOJ9ASQUVFh5kD+OzOnYdi7n3Wpm9hWWGfB/O2blfHcMVTL5WkQXSnRiK9makhrcnw==`.

No CDN request or browser-side package installation is needed. Summary text
never leaves the browser for comparison.
